_why: NIGHT40 builder S1 (design.n40.kiln40 swaps n38-kiln for this file): Tools/night/gen-n40-kiln.cjs, NIGHT39 K4's n38-kiln with the THUNDERCLAP in hand from the start (no pickup), the boost taught as a chain in 3.1 (the sim's), the KESTREL and the PULSE gauntlet by room entry (design.n40.kiln40.awards). K4's level: Tools/night/gen-n38-kiln.cjs from the beat sheet Design/levels/n38/kiln.beats.md. The level of the THUNDERCLAP and its CLIMB (jump, shoot down, double jump, shoot down): 3.1 THE CHARGE (the gun up close, one boost onto the rim), 3.1b THE FLUE (gate G1: the climb taught), 3.2 POUR HALL (an open roofed arena: boost THROUGH the pack onto the crucible), 3.2b THE STACK (gates G2a / G2b: two climbs), 3.3 CASTING FLOOR (ride over the pour, climb to the ladle, slug, parry, launch), 3.3b THE SPOUT (gate G3: a climb out of a run over a pit), 3.4 REST, 3.5 THE RING (THE KILN WYRM, its AI unchanged, in its new arena). Every gate a noride cliff 12 m high: over the PULSE blast's 7.75 m + 10 %, under the climb's 13.36 m. Numbers from Design/levels/envelopes38.json (builder E, the real sim: every non-boost apex, the climb `jump+double+boost x2` / x3) + E's checker b13c7802 (blast + wall jump 11.31 m) + K4's round-2 sweep.
